Text: {school}'s star dean has been poached by {rival}, along with her emotional support chatbot.
A billionaire has donated a building to {school} that nobody asked for. Upkeep begins immediately.
Applications to {school} tripled. The admissions office has walked out and taken the coffee maker.
A glowing magazine profile of {school} has prompted an investigation into everything in it.
The {mascot}s' coach has demanded a raise larger than the library budget. It was granted.
{school} has been asked to host the Big Digit Conference summit. All of it. Indefinitely.
AI Corpone has named {school} his favorite university, which is never good news.
{school}'s ranking has been printed on a tote bag. Faculty consider this the end of an era.
The Office of Regression to the Mean has opened a satellite office on {school}'s campus.
{school}'s success has attracted 4,000 consultants. They are all billing.
{rival} has hired away {school}'s entire IT department by promising them windows that open.
An alumnus has demanded his degree be revoked so he can brag about getting in again now.
{school} trended worldwide for six hours. Nobody can agree what for.
AI Corpone has asked {school} to star in a commercial. The script calls for the president to wear a jetpack.
The rankings success went to {school}'s head. The president has commissioned a statue of the rankings.
Every other university in the Big Digit Conference has formed a group chat about {school}. {school} is not in it.
{school}'s servers were overwhelmed by applicants. The backup servers were the dorms.
A prestigious award was given to {school} and then, after a recount by an AI, to {rival}.
{school} has been featured in a documentary titled "Too Big to Grade."
The board of trustees has voted to rename {school} after its own ranking. The signage alone costs a fortune.
